main_text.head: INDEX

p.i: ANIMA et NATVRA differunt apud Gal. Esti id vero à Stoicis, 8.2. mundi Platonica, 28.4. animam totam esse totam in corpore, etc. falsum est, 15.9.

main_text.p: {a}"Αττ, prapositio intendit significationem, ut in διὰ λαμβάνω et ἀπὸ τῆς, 14.2, 3.18.
"Ἀπὸ ἀληθείας, ἢ ἀπὸ ἀληθείας, ἀπὸ ἀληθείας, νοῦ ἀπὸ ἀληθεῖ, 1 4.2.

p.i: Apoplexia non est affectus foporosus 13. 50. ut differat à paralysi 14.7.57. ab epilepsia 1b.9.10. à suffocatione uterina, 1b.11. à Caro, 1b.12. à syncope et synco-pe cardiacâ 1b.13. subito mori, non est signum ejus pathognomicum, Ibidem.24. signum aliud 1b.25. species non nisi una est gravitate differens 1b.31. hæc sanguinea dicitur, 10.5.17. 14.17.38. species, sunt gradus, 14.25. parva, quæ? 1b 26. differentia à loco affectu nulla est, 1b.27, 29. non est in ventriculis, sed in corpore, seu vafis, 1b 34.36. utrobique esse, quod sensu dicatur? 13.80. 14:32. in cerebri ventriculis inventa aqua unde sit? 10.15. an falsi sint sensus interni? 13.79. an pueri illa laborent? 11.17. quibus sensibus fit familiaris? 1b. et 10:17. quomodo fiat.

page.notes: The text is partly illegible at the edges; the Greek and marginal references are only approximately read. Several words are doubtful and not marked individually; the transcription of the Greek and numerals is uncertain.
